pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped sub-polygonal regions with rounded vertices. Edge boundaries exhibit smooth pixel gradients with low-contrast transitions. Spatial area of individual patches is high relative to the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways. Topological graph consists of primarily trivalent and tetravalent junction nodes. Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing at the lateral flank junctions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, fuzzy 1D silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The contour displays high-frequency textural irregularities rather than distinct sharp geometric spikes.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized cluster of significant textural disruptions along the dorsal ridge and upper shoulder. Visible as raised, nodular, and hyper-pigmented protrusions with irregular surface geometry.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct raised nodular lesions and crusty textural masses are present on the upper flank and dorsal ridge, indicating localized pathology or parasitic infection.
